title: oh my teams structured document common envelope v1
$comment: docs/plan/structured-omt-documents.md 3.2 (common envelope) and 3.7 (revision model, state field). Every document-*.schema.json repeats this shape in its own `required`/`properties` because the repository has no cross-file $ref precedent (task.schema.json, review.schema.json, organization.schema.json each stay self-contained); this file documents the shared shape once for reference.

docId.$comment: 3.5: `<kickoffHash>/<workflowId|none>/<stageSlug>/<docType>/<localId>`. The exact segment grammar is pinned per document type in that type's own schema, not here, because stageSlug/docType/localId derivation differ per type (3.5, 3.7 item 7).

stage.$comment: stageSlug (3.5), not the folder name string (3.1's `01. 기획` etc). Each document type pins this to a single value.

kickoffId.$comment: kickoffHash = sha256(worktreeId + createdAt + registrationSeq) (3.7 item 7, contract A).

workflowId.$comment: null before a workflow exists for this kickoff (e.g. `01. 기획` documents, 3.7 item 4). String form matches WORKFLOW_ID_PATTERN (workflow-store.mjs).

state.$comment: 3.3, 3.7 item 7 contract B. review-ref/acceptance-ref/delivery-ref are pinned to `resolved` in their own schema because they are written only after their backing record already carries the approval.

basedOnRevision.$comment: null for a document's first revision.
